exact_statement: For uniform Boolean signs, four total input variables are necessary and sufficient for this mechanism: an occupied parent full Fourier atom, a physical singleton query whose coherent kernel annihilates that erased spike on a noncharacter child, and a required positive tilt at that child essential mask. The balanced stable-mask circuit f(a,x,y,z)=mux_z(chi_x,chi_y) for a=0 and chi_xyz for a=1 attains it. For every 0<alpha<1 its supplied parent full-spike reference transports to exact spectra on both children. A required child tilt 0<gamma<1 costs -log2(1-gamma) on the multiplexer outcome, zero on parity, hence paired price -log2(1-gamma)/2. At alpha=gamma=1/2, original KL=1-log2(5)/4<1/2=paired fresh KL by 5>4. H(f)=3 and I(f)=11/4; this is an additional reference-floor invoice, not FEI or original influence-account insolvency.
hypotheses: Finite uniform Boolean signs; complete physical query with both outcomes and all source-zero reference atoms retained; bit units.
Minimality is restricted to annihilation of an occupied full-root spike on a noncharacter child, not arbitrary reference failure.
Parent matching-empty full-spike supplied; required new positive profile is an additional interface hypothesis, not a necessary FEI operation.
proof_dependencies: Self-contained Fourier expansion, coherent normalization and exact integer sign 5>4; small-dimension Boolean classification

refutes: A positive fresh essential-mask tilt can always be installed for free after annihilation of the original full-mask spike.

exact_statement: For a finite normalized law p partitioned into vacuum V and N with pi=p(N)>0 and normalized finite-CE q with rho=q(N)>0, suppose q(.|N)=(1-beta)p(.|N)+beta delta_M, 0<=beta<1. Let R_gamma copy p on V and have conditional profile (1-gamma)p(.|N)+gamma delta_E on N. For any required spike-parameter floor 0<=ell<1, the minimum signed CE price over ell<=gamma<1 is pi[d_tE(ell)-d_tM(beta)]-L, where t_j=p(j)/pi, L=sum_V p log2(p/q)+pi log2(pi/rho)>=0 and d_t(u)=(1-t)log2(1/(1-u))+t log2(t/(t+u(1-t))), with continuous endpoints. All full-terminal conversions are payable from the SAME supplied original unused capacity iff their actual reach-weighted signed prices sum to at most B-C-U. For A049 balanced four-bit mux/parity circuit and every alpha,gamma in(0,1), both inherited child KLs vanish; the query consumes ALL original entry KL and a required fresh floor adds -log2(1-gamma)/2>0. No necessary floor or original O(I) source or full FEI theorem follows.
hypotheses: Finite normalized p,q; finite CE; pi>0; beta<1; declared target E may be source-zero.
Floor means spike parameter, not atom mass or fixed within-cell profile.
Both physical outcomes, normalizers, ghost mass, old debits and full terminals retained; B,C,U genuinely supplied.
gamma<=beta sufficient only for same mask or source-zero-old-mask retarget, not arbitrary unrelated target.
proof_dependencies: Self-contained finite KL chain rule/log-sum, atomwise expansion and differentiation
refutes: A fully consumed original entry-KL budget can be reused to pay a required fresh positive child floor.
first_unproved_line: A necessary useful arbitrary-core profile and ORIGINAL O(I) complete source with actual unused surplus and all query losses/full terminal entropy paid.
